subject: Private deployment fee mix: platform fee vs node credits / pilot and oncall
messages:
From: Alex Hansen <alex.hansen@spectramed.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@spectramed.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private deployment fee mix and SLA carveouts

Diego / Marissa —

Thanks for the product briefing last week. Procurement asked me to capture a couple specific asks so we can compare final numbers across vendors:

1) We want to understand tradeoffs between a higher annual platform fee (amortized across the contract) vs. a lower platform fee combined with node-anchored credits (i.e., a seatless operator model where we pay per-node or per-site).
2) Implementation/onboarding credits — SpectraMed typically asks for 15–25% of first-year fees back as an implementation credit to fund our SRE time.
3) Pilot mechanics: 30-day pilot with reduced platform fee, clear SLA for response times during pilot, and an exit data export/format guarantee (we need to know any chargebacks).

Attached is our RFP and a short checklist for SOC 2 and backup retention. Can you send a short commercial write-up with two clear options and expected monthly/annual cashflows?

Appreciate a tight turnaround — procurement wants options by EOD Thursday (1/22).

[Attachment: SpectraMed_RFP.pdf]

— Alex

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment fee mix and SLA carveouts

Alex —

Thanks for the clear asks and the RFP. High-level approach below; Marissa will follow with a term sheet and numbers by tomorrow.

Summary (two-option construct):

Option A — Platform-first (simpler ops):
- Annual platform fee covers control plane, observability retention (90 days), and basic SRE oncall (8x5)
- Lower per-node charge for burst capacity
- Implementation credit up to 15% on signed multiyear commitment

Option B — Node-anchored (lower fixed fee):
- Lower platform fee (anchored to pilot scale) + per-node credits for production nodes
- One-time implementation credit (typically 20% of year-1 committed spend) to offset migration costs
- Optional SRE retainer for 24x7 coverage (separate line item)

Pilot ask: we can do a 30-day pilot. Two pilot concessions we can offer: 50% platform fee deferral for pilot period, and a capped implementation credit applied at contract signature. Exit/export: no vendor lock on data exports — we will include an export format clause; export run cost is typically labor + egress; we can cap outbound egress at a nominal amount in the pilot contract.

Operational note: our Private (VPC) offering includes SOC 2 artifacts and an audit-ready evidence pack; we can include a short statement in the term sheet.

Marissa — can you attach a quick term sheet with line-item pricing and a short SOW (implementation credit applied against onboarding invoice)?

I'll pencil a call with Alex if procurement wants to walk numbers.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 21 Jan 2026 08:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment fee mix and SLA carveouts — term sheet attached

Alex / Diego —

Attaching a concise term sheet with two price options and the proposed SOW (implementation credit mechanics). Key excerpts below so procurement can scan quickly. Full line items are in the attached XLSX.

Option A (Platform-first) — annualized:
- Platform fee: $120,000 / year (includes control plane, 90d observability retention, 8x5 oncall)
- Node credits: 100 production node credits included; additional at $360/node/month
- Implementation credit: 15% of first-year invoice applied as credit against onboarding invoice

Option B (Node-anchored) — annualized:
- Platform fee: $48,000 / year (pilot scale; scales with contract)
- Node credits: 100 production node credits included; additional at $300/node/month
- Implementation credit: 20% of first-year committed spend (applied as a one-time credit at signature)
- Optional 24x7 SRE retainer: $12,000/month (covers escalation and oncall)

Pilot concession we can sign to: 30-day pilot with 50% platform fee deferment (applies to Option B pilot), capped export egress charge $2,500 for pilot if export requested.

Attachments: RI-vpc-term-sheet-v2.xlsx (pricing grid + SOW).

Next steps: please indicate preferred option and whether you want the SRE retainer included in the commercial. I can prepare a redlined SOW for signature and a short DocuSign link once we have alignment.

[Attachment: RI-vpc-term-sheet-v2.xlsx]

From: Alex Hansen <alex.hansen@spectramed.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@spectramed.com
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment fee mix and SLA carveouts — term sheet attached

Marissa / Diego —

Thanks for the clear options. Procurement leaned to Option B (node-anchored) but have two change asks before we move to a redline:

1) Pilot: SpectraMed needs SPI (service performance indicators) tightened during pilot — P1 response time SLA at 4 hours and a named escalation path. We're willing to accept the 30-day duration but need the SLA written into the pilot paperwork.
2) Implementation credit: accept 20% but request that 50% of that credit be applied as a pre-funded onboarding allowance (credited to invoices) so we can hire a 3rd-party integrator quickly.

Also: exit data export — we want the export to be provided in ndjson or parquet, and we need confirmation that the export script will include message-level metadata (timestamps and request IDs). Any additional charges beyond the $2,500 pilot cap should be communicated up front.

If you can accept the two pilot modifications, procurement will greenlight a redline and we can target signature in the week after next.

— Alex
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: negotiation path and concessions approved for SpectraMed

Marissa / Karthik —

Quick internal note after Alex's asks: we can accept both pilot modifications with the following guardrails.

1) Pilot SLA: agree to P1 4-hour response and named escalation for pilot only; include a clause that pilot SLAs are target-level and will be replaced by standard SLA language in the production SOW (production SLA will be 1 hour P1 for enterprise with SRE retainer).

2) Implementation credit structure: approve 20% credit with 50% paid as a pre-funded onboarding allowance (applies to Option B). The pre-funded portion will be recorded as a credit on the initial invoice and netted against invoices for 60 days.

3) Export format: agree to ndjson/parquet export with message-level metadata. For pilot we will cap at $2,500; for production exports we will include a standard hourly rate (capped) in the SOW.

Approve moving to a redline with those concessions. Marissa — please prepare a redlined term sheet and a DocuSign link reflecting the pilot SLA & pre-funded credit mechanics. Karthik — please confirm the SRE retainer cost in writing so it can be included as an optional addendum.

Diego
